paragraphs: The UniBox NAV-50 is an intelligent access controller and hotspot gateway designed to provide comprehensive control over your wireless network. It empowers network administrators to centrally manage both wired and wireless networks, preventing unauthorized access while tracking real-time network activity.

Engineered for seamless integration, the NAV-50 features a built-in captive portal engine, bandwidth controller, policy manager, URL tracker, and reporting system. It is fully compatible with the WiOS Cloud Hotspot Manager for centralized monitoring of remote units.

features: Universal controller with Gigabit LAN & WAN ports
Rate limiting and dynamic bandwidth allocation
Fair usage policies with date/time and group-based rules
Limits based on time and data usage
Multiple login methods including social login and SMS/OTP
User isolation, MAC blacklisting, TRAI/DOT compliance
Detailed analytics on users, usage, and revenue
Social media profiling and PMS/Voucher activity
Web logging, archiving, and URL filtering

products.summary: This intelligent access controller and hotspot gateway is designed for small venues, supporting up to 50 concurrent users. Built on a reliable Linux platform with Gigabit connectivity, it delivers enterprise-grade bandwidth management, captive portals, and robust security for complete wireless network control.

products.title: AAA (Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting) Server
products.tagline: Unified identity and authentication management for demanding networks
products.description: The UniBox U-5050 is an all-in-one AAA server and network access controller appliance for large, demanding environments. It combines wireless LAN control, hotspot gateway, billing, bandwidth management, web logging, VPN, policy management, load balancing, and firewall capabilities in a single box.
products.productType: AAA (Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting) Server U-5050
products.heroDescription: The U-5050 combines authentication, authorization, accounting, hotspot gateway, billing, bandwidth management, VPN, policy, load balancing, and firewall functions in one controller appliance. It supports 500 concurrent active sessions and scales up to 10,000 users for airports, premium hotels, campuses, public hotspots, and telecom environments.

paragraphs: The Rizonn UniBox U-5050 is a high-performance AAA server and intelligent access controller built for large environments such as airports, premium hotels, educational campuses, telecom deployments, healthcare facilities, public hotspots, and transport hubs.

It provides a unified platform for authentication, authorization, and accounting while also functioning as a wireless LAN controller, hotspot gateway, web server, load balancer, web logger, VPN server, policy server, and firewall.

The integrated AAA engine supports BYOD onboarding with self-service authorization and certificate-based machine authentication for non-Active Directory mobile devices such as tablets and iPads, helping teams deliver secure and flexible access control across diverse device types.

features: Built-in user database with per-device and per-user credential management
Integration with external identity systems including RADIUS, AD, and LDAP
Certificate-based machine authentication for mobile devices
Group-based, fair usage, and date/time policies
Multiple PMS integration with canned and automated emails
Two-factor SMS/OTP logins, social media login, and ad integration
Online users, usage, revenue, PMS, voucher, and network monitoring reports

products.conclusion: A unified AAA server and network access controller for large-scale guest and enterprise networks, combining identity management, hotspot billing, policy enforcement, reporting, and security in one appliance.
